## Open Leonardo documents and forms
- Author open `.mdlf` documents with versioned JSON metadata and Markdown content. Ordinary `.md` files retain standard Markdown behavior. - Export `.mdlr` forms that open ready to fill, with typed fields, validation and answers stored separately from the document body. Draft answers can be saved before validation is complete. - Configure backgrounds, image sizing and placement, and table widths. - Transport documents and local assets in conventional `.mdlz` ZIP packages. Work directly in the package or extract to a chosen folder; visible indicators show the working format, mode and save target. - Preserve package assets, external-change conflicts and source documents across save/export operations. - Keep preference scope inside the active tab; package-open and migration settings apply across the Mac. - Use the included Codex/Claude plugin contract and Python helper to generate, validate, inspect, extract and repack MDLZ.
To receive beta updates, choose Beta in Preferences → Updates. Fresh installations keep Stable selected until you opt in.
This beta is intended for validation of the new document workflows. Hosted update/install/relaunch acceptance is tracked separately; publication does not claim those checks or install the application on the maintainer’s Mac.
Source change: https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/168

## Improvements and fixes
- Home presents recent documents, projects and workspaces in separate tabs alongside persistent favorites. - Larger Leonardo lettering sits behind the Home content without reserving a top band, and the background adapts to smaller windows. - Recent projects and workspaces no longer appear twice when the same folder is opened through different URL forms. Existing duplicate history is cleaned on load while preserving order and favorite stars.
## Distribution
Stable release for Apple silicon (arm64), macOS 14 or later. Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized, retaining the existing Sparkle update key.
Promotes beta 0.1.404, validated by the owner with confirmation that duplicate entries are resolved. The functional code and dependencies are unchanged; a new higher build is used for stable updates. General updater channel-matrix acceptance remains tracked separately in issues #15 and #84.
